race.comment: Very even with a host of these close to wins. One of those is KING INCANTO (3) who doesn't win out of turn but deserves to break through having placed in five of his last six runs. Beaten a neck in a similar race last time at Wangaratta and can go one better. FROZEN TIDE (2) finished fourth last time but was beaten just over a length. Drawn to stalk the pace again and looks a leading chance. CABLE DE VEGA (5) was just out of the frame fresh then improved to finish third last time when out to a mile. Looks ready to win and gets chance. AVONVIEW (1) placed in similar grade at Bairnsdale last time but over much further. Comes off a let-up but boasts a very good record this circuit. Has to be included. PHOENICIAN (4) placed fresh and can only be fitter.
